13 June 1935

Dear Dr. Finkelstein,

I have to cancel the letter I wrote yesterday. I have to travel for an interview tomorrow. We will come on Saturday as you suggested before. I am sorry to have to alter the arrangement.

Yours sincerely,

(signed) Lionel Pendlebury
